paper.title_en: A conformal reduction for the X-ADM mass
paper.abstract_en: The X-ADM mass is a generalisation of the ADM mass for asymptotically flat manifolds, recently introduced by Mantegazza and Oronzio [arXiv:2602.11372], who proved a positive mass theorem for this quantity in dimension $3$ under a certain topological condition. In this article, we prove the X-positive mass theorem with rigidity in all dimensions $n\geq3$ without any topological restrictions. To this end, we first prove that the scalar curvature condition appearing in the X-positive mass theorem implies the metric is of positive Yamabe type. We then show that the X-ADM mass of the given metric is equal to the ADM mass of a scalar-flat representative in its conformal class plus a term that is explicitly non-negative. From this, the X-positive mass theorem follows from the standard positive mass theorem. As a corollary, we obtain the Riemannian mass--charge inequality of general relativity in all dimensions, which was previously only known for spin manifolds. Finally, we give a version of the X-positive mass theorem for a manifold with boundary.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在任意维数 n≥3 且无拓扑限制下证明带刚性条件的 X-正质量定理，并将其约化为共形类中标量平坦代表度量的标准 ADM 质量，从而导出广义 Riemannian 质量-电荷不等式（此前仅对旋量流形成立），理论上与广义相对论基础中的正质量定理与质量定义直接相关，值得点开细读。
decision.title_zh: X-ADM 质量的一种共形约化
decision.abstract_zh: X-ADM 质量是渐近平坦流形上 ADM 质量的一种推广，由 Mantegazza 和 Oronzio [arXiv:2602.11372] 最近引入，他们在维数 $3$ 下、在一个特定拓扑条件下为该量证明了正质量定理。在本文中，我们在所有维数 $n\geq3$ 下、不加任何拓扑限制地证明了带刚性条件的 X-正质量定理。为此，我们首先证明 X-正质量定理中出现的标量曲率条件蕴含该度量具有正 Yamabe 型。随后我们证明，给定度量的 X-ADM 质量等于其共形类中某个标量平坦代表度量的 ADM 质量加上一个显式非负的项。由此，X-正质量定理可由标准的正质量定理推出。作为一个推论，我们得到了广义相对论在所有维数下的 Riemannian 质量–电荷不等式，该不等式此前仅在旋量流形上已知。最后，我们给出了带边界流形的 X-正质量定理的一个版本。
